Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misidentified the aircraft as the “YB-17 Flying Fortress (prototype)” when Major Ployer “Pete” Hill died test-flying NX13372, the original Boeing Model 299 prototype later referred to as the XB-17—not a YB-17. This conflated designations and introduced a factual error, even though the overarching aircraft family (B-17 Flying Fortress) was correct.
